subject: Bench SDK S4: warm.py — pre-learnt KB snapshot load/produce
description: bench/zonoid_bench/warm.py — so we DON'T relearn the bench repo each run. load_snapshot(snapshot, workspace): INJECT a pre-learnt KB into the bench daemon's workspace — Level A: re-inject drained batches via scripts/onboard-learn.js --inject --confirm --workspace <abs> (ORCH_GATE_OFF=1 child env, --model sonnet) [the cheap path, skips MINE+DRAIN]; Level B (optional cache): copy a materialized .graph tarball in. Also support static AGENTS.md (FB_KB_PATH-style) passthrough. produce_snapshot(repo, base_commit, out): run the EXPENSIVE mine+drain ONCE (wrap bench/swe-bench-cl/warm_start.js's mine→enqueue→drain), emit the snapshot keyed by (repo, base_commit) per bench/featurebench-kb/pilot-manifest.json. Reuse warm_start.js + onboard-learn.js (do NOT reinvent). The snapshot artifacts already exist for some repos under bench/onboard/<repo>/. Commit on the attempt branch.
